from pathlib import Path
import os,re,json,subprocess,shutil
root=Path('/opt');app=root/'telegram-robot-leads'
archives=sorted(root.glob('.telegram-leads-previous-*'))
assert len(archives)==8, 'archive inventory changed'
for q in archives:
 assert q.parent==root and re.fullmatch(r'\.telegram-leads-previous-[0-9a-f]{12}',q.name)
 assert q.is_dir() and not q.is_symlink() and q.stat().st_uid==0
 assert (q/'.verified-source-commit').is_file()
 assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}',(q/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip())
 assert (q/'main.py').is_file() and (q/'scripts/safe_runtime.py').is_file()
 for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(q):
  if '/.venv/' in folder:continue
  assert not any(name.endswith('.session') or name in ('.env','accounts.json','operation-state.json') for name in files),'private data in archive'
result=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=12)
apps=json.loads(result.stdout)
active=[x for x in apps if x.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
assert len(active)==1 and active[0]['pm2_env']['status']=='online'
assert active[0]['pm2_env']['pm_cwd']==str(app)
assert active[0]['pm2_env']['pm_exec_path']==str(app/'main.py')
def proc_references(candidates):
 for p in Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*'):
  for leaf in ('cwd','exe'):
   try:
    value=os.readlink(p/leaf)
    if any(value==str(q) or value.startswith(str(q)+'/') for q in candidates):return (p.name,leaf)
   except OSError:pass
 return None
assert proc_references(archives) is None,'live process references archived release'
keep=max(archives,key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime)
delete=[q for q in archives if q!=keep]
print('ARCHIVES_VALIDATED',len(archives),'KEEP',keep.name,'DELETE',len(delete),flush=True)
sumkb=0
for q in delete:
 size=subprocess.run(['du','-sk',str(q)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=10)
 kb=int(size.stdout.split()[0])
 shutil.rmtree(q)
 assert not q.exists()
 sumkb+=kb
 print('ARCHIVE_REMOVED',q.name,'kib',kb,flush=True)
remaining=sorted(root.glob('.telegram-leads-previous-*'))
assert remaining==[keep]
check=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=12)
after=[x for x in json.loads(check.stdout) if x.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
assert len(after)==1 and after[0]['pm2_env']['status']=='online'
print('ARCHIVE_CLEAN_PASS','saved_kib',sumkb,'retained',keep.name,'pm2_restart_count',after[0]['pm2_env']['restart_time'],flush=True)
PY
